summary: 3D paper-marbling art puzzle: sprinkle, comb and shape paint on the water, then lay the paper, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Kitreli suda boya serp, tara, lale aç ve kâğıdı yatır: 3D ebru bulmacası, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: Deterministic mathematical-marbling simulation: drops push older paint outward, the awl leaves a chevron wake, the comb pulls 25 tines; colours never mix
18 lessons in 3 chapters (basic, combed, flower ebru) with TR / EN notes from the master; every target is a replayed stroke recipe, so every lesson is solvable
Live match %, ghost hint of the next stroke, up to 3 stars per lesson (54 in all), free tray with a 12-sheet gallery
Paint rasterised on the GPU with a stencil pass into a multisampled render target; 60 fps on an Intel UHD 620
The ?auto bot plays all 18 lessons through the same stroke API as a player; one index.html, everything generated in code
